messages:
ana (docs): Heads-up  I'm opening a focused PR to add deployment-mode columns and a short data locality FAQ. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/833 :memo:
matt (eng-platform): Thanks. Can you include endpoint hostnames per region and mark which regions have hosted KMS wrapping?
ana (docs): (typo) meant ana ^ :-) Yes, table columns = region, endpoint, hosted, dedicated, private, kms, notes.
lee (product): Add a short note for customers migrating to Dedicated: update base URL, rotate keys, verify IP allowlist and model pinning. Keep it as bullets.
sera (legal): Use "data locality" not "residency". Approved wording to paste: "We may process or store customer data in the geographic region selected for your tenancy. Contractual data locality guarantees are available via enterprise agreements." Save exact string for PR.
matt (eng-platform): KMS wrapping (hosted): us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. Dedicated supports customer KMS; Private depends on customer. ap-southeast-1 Dedicated is beta.
ana (docs): I'll paste Sera's sentence verbatim and add DPA footnote for EU-DE. Also will include a tiny curl + python SDK snippet showing region param.
pr-bot: CI reminder  PR 833 created by ana: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/833  checks queued.
ana (docs): Pushing now. Tagging @matt for a quick check on endpoint hostnames and @sera for legal sign-off.
matt (eng-platform): Quick nit: avoid hard SLO numbers in docs, link to /docs/performance instead.
sera (legal): I'll review the paragraph in the PR and leave comments if wording needs tightening. Don't promise residency without Sales/DPA.
ana (docs): Got it. Thanks all 44d: marking thread pending reviews.
